description: Will this appliance physically fit this space? Compares dimensions plus typical installation clearances and required connections (power, water, gas).

needs.description: Connections the product needs, e.g. '120V, water line' or '240V'.

opening.description: Width, height and depth of the space it goes into. Any subset is accepted; missing axes come back as 'missing'.

depth.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

height.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

width.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

product.description: What's being installed, e.g. '36-inch French-door refrigerator'. Used to pick typical clearances.

product_dimensions.description: Width, height and depth of the product (from its spec sheet). Any subset is accepted; missing axes come back as 'missing'.

depth.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

height.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

width.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

name: check_fit

candidates.description: Present when the text matched several models: each option with its own verdict.

conditions.description: What must be true for a conditional answer (accessory, dependency).

confidence.description: Evidence score from fixed rules (source tier, rule strength). Not a calibrated probability: act on decision, conditions and questions.

decision.description: supported | conditional | incompatible | insufficient_evidence. Act on this, not on confidence alone.

questions.description: Exactly what to ask, measure or look up next. blocking=true means no decision until answered.

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EdDSA JWS) proving Tethered Trust issued this verdict unaltered. Not a guarantee the verdict is correct.

valid_until.description: When this answer should be re-checked (based on how fresh its sources are).

verified.description: True only when every spec came from a manufacturer source with a recorded check date.

title: Check physical fit
